title: Electricity: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Electric storage and draw use internal charge units; Generator Output is internal charge per simulated second. Battery Charge reads a 0 to 1 fraction and electric port inspection shows the EMP-adjusted supply fraction, both without a unit. A conversion of internal charge to joules or watts was not recovered.

Shaft speed is RPS, and a simple shaft group mixes speeds weighted by force_emitter_max_force plus weight 1 for the group's previous speed. How arbitrary gearbox and clutch networks, conflicting ratio loops and connector rebuilds combine groups was not decoded, and the model gives no SI torque or inertia.

Component updates run 60 times per simulated second, so 60 × the charge per update is the charge per simulated second, in internal units. Generator Output already includes that factor. The shaft solver weights speed changes by force_emitter_max_force and has no torque or inertia in SI units, so it gives no charge-per-joule figure for mechanical work. The shipped realtime file sets electric_consumption_scale to 0.01, but the executable contains that name neither as ASCII nor as UTF-16LE text, and its effect was not recovered.

title: Fluids: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Native coverage for this build: ordinary and enclosed pipe networks, fixed liquid and gas tanks, the electric, impeller, modular and manual pumps, both filters, the old Hose and mechanical winches, rope-hook hoses, hose pulleys and the fluid connector. Custom-compartment volume from wall geometry and hull flooding were not decoded. Diesel and jet-fuel tank startup, startup from saved inventory, handheld hose free ends, slurry processing and steam or seawater behaviour outside the selected phase-change callers were not traced. The four realtime fluid damping names do not occur in the executable, so their effect on this build was not recovered.

The shipped realtime file lists gas and liquid base damping 0.99 and 0.9999, but none of the four fluid damping names occurs in the executable, so no setting binding was recovered. To test for an effect, compare two values of a setting on the same layout and starting inventory. Check Flow Rate against the solver bounds on the actual network graph: pipe length adds no volume, and hoses and connectors link networks at factor 1 or 0.5. Check a prefab gas tank's start (59.4 atm decoded) separately from a fluid-spawner compartment (60 atm in its tooltip).

title: Impeller Pump: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Static analysis of one build; the flow figures are equal-pressure bounds, not measured flow. The shaft load unit was not established.

The impeller reads the speed of the shaft on its RPS port and pushes with bias 4 × |RPS| × pump_pressure. Spinning the shaft backward pushes the same way. Unlike the electric pumps it is two-way: backpressure can push fluid back through it, and at low flow it exchanges temperature between its two networks. The shaft port records a load request of 0.1 × pump_pressure; its torque unit was not established.

title: Air drag and lift tuning: resolve missing mechanics

title: Aircraft propellers and rotor controls: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Input ranges are not degrees or turns. Blade aerodynamics, cyclic phase, reaction torque, torque-to-thrust conversion, underwater reduction and ground effect are not recovered.

title: Buoyancy and water drag: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The SDK documents water density as 1000 and exposes separate pressure, suction, viscous and wave-slamming terms. The realtime file enables named drag and slamming switches. SDK buoyancy_mass_multiplier is 10, while realtime buoyancy_mass_multiplier is 12. Keep both sources visible: their loading order and runtime authority have not been established.
A multiplier is not enough to derive displacement, buoyancy force or a mass-to-volume formula. No claim about watertight compartment simulation follows from these settings.

title: Composite data over electrical cables: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The electrical cable anchor tooltip permits one rope logic link between two anchors, carrying data and electricity. Its ports describe composite, on/off, video and audio send and receive paths. This establishes the documented transport interface. It does not establish a composite channel count, packet format or microcontroller execution model.

Channel numbering, boolean and numeric channel layout, update order, transport latency, microcontroller limits and Lua scheduling require further evidence. The inspected microprocessor definition has empty tooltip descriptions and supplies no basis for those claims.

title: Magnetic connectors, transfers and hardpoints: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Attachment distance, force limits, transfer capacities and losses, update latency and ordnance-type numeric mapping are unresolved. Free flow is tooltip wording rather than a measured lossless-transfer claim. Launch describes the interface signal, not a recovered weapon activation implementation.

title: Diesel engine connections and startup: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The diesel use, speed step, heating, 115 °C overheat threshold and starter request equations come from that native decode. Thermal efficiency in physical units and a conversion of the shaft model to SI torque were not recovered.

title: Batteries and generators: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Capacity units, voltage and conversion to joules or watts remain unknown. Consumption of components outside the traced native updates and the effect of electric_consumption_scale were not recovered.

title: Environment and hazard tuning: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The environment file places sunrise markers at 6, 7.5 and 9 hours and sunset markers at 16, 17.5 and 19. Tornado and whirlpool tuning separate vertical, radial and tangential terms. These names expose independent settings, but do not establish damage, safe distances or the force falloff formula.
Lighting markers are not proof of mission schedules or latitude-dependent astronomical sunrise. Hazard spawning and damage behavior require separate addon and native analysis.

title: Fluid tanks, pumps and damping: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: No unit or delivered head is documented for pump_pressure. The effect of the realtime damping entries on this build was not recovered; their names do not occur in the executable.

title: Jet startup, turbines and afterburners: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The ignition, fuel, compressor, combustion, turbine and exhaust equations come from that native decode. Physical units of jet pressure and temperature were not established, and SI torque, power and efficiency were not recovered. The equilibrium and startup time of an assembled engine were not traced, because how ducts and branches connect the parts was not reconstructed. The afterburner's steady fuel draw through its Fuel port was not recovered. The medium turbine port described as torque carries RPS with solver weight 160, not a torque in N m.

title: Underwater propellers and pitch control: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The small boat propeller receives engine power and its tooltip says it operates only underwater. The controllable-pitch boat propeller also requires underwater operation and takes desired pitch from -1 to 1. Its force_emitter_max_force field is 80000 versus 20000 for the selected small fixed-pitch propeller. These fields are configuration values and do not establish measured thrust or a speed-to-force equation.
No newtons, blade angle, cavitation, water-relative speed curve, stall behavior or propulsive efficiency is inferred from these fields or input ranges.

title: Modular engine assembly and telemetry: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The air:fuel window, efficiency, speed impulse and channel scaling come from that native decode. Composite value 1 is not established as litres of atmospheric air: it is 6000 × admitted oxygen, ten times the gas-litre factor the fluid tooltips use. An SI conversion from fuel to torque, power or energy was not recovered.

title: Configuration loading and native defaults: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The native constants serializer also supplies 10.0 for buoyancy_mass_multiplier. The SDK says 10 and the shipped realtime settings say 12. This trace does not establish which value wins during gameplay.
Both named fields and fallback values are present in the recovered serializer but absent from the supplied SDK XML attributes. The force equation and effective runtime values are unresolved.

The native component serializer passes these literal names and destination offsets to the float helper. A serialized field does not establish that every component uses it or define its physical units.

title: Nuclear fuel assemblies and control rods: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Reaction kinetics, adjacency radius, insertion direction and range, fuel lifetime, heat transfer, radiation and meltdown thresholds remain unresolved. No numeric nuclear type is translated into an inferred enum name.

title: Base fuel inventory transfers: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: No wall-clock callback rate or fluid conservation across server APIs was measured. Mixed-fluid behavior requires runtime validation.

title: SDK radar and sonar noise defaults: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The SDK documents sonar_noise and radar_noise as positive and negative ranges of small discrepancies in reported positions. Both defaults are 0.001. It separately describes radar_distance_noise, default 0.01, as a maximum percentage discrepancy in reported distance. The descriptions do not establish a distribution, update cadence or exact coordinate interpretation.
No Gaussian, uniform or distance-dependent noise formula is assumed. The SDK description does not by itself prove active radar or sonar error bounds.

title: Speed, altitude and radar signals: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: This article covers the selected radar definition only. Target signature, occlusion, scan timing and other radar variants are not established.

title: Fireboxes, boilers and condensers: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Boiling temperature, pressure limits, rupture behavior, heat transfer, coal burn rate, phase conversion ratio and thermal units are not established. Port labels do not establish flow direction enforcement or measured rates.

title: Steam turbines and piston timing: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: No turbine torque curve, exhaust-pressure relationship, piston stroke unit, position range, valve timing equation or conversion efficiency was recovered. Repeated port labels are preserved without inventing distinctions between them.

title: Gear ratios and clutch engagement: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Ratio orientation, available ratios, torque units, losses, clutch slip curves and failure behavior are not established. No ideal gearbox equation or linear engagement-to-power relationship is assumed.

title: Weapon loading, ammunition and timed fuses: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: Barrel-length fields retain their serialized names and do not establish a muzzle-velocity formula. title: Wheels, grip and suspension: resolve missing mechanics
